Can this document’s data be tied to a place?

A plain-language look at Project Appraisal and Project Information Documents.

We reviewed 6,470 passages across the geospatial review. 3,804 matched a Project Appraisal or Project Information Document, covering 6,503 data mentions. of those mentions are tied to a place such as a district, a monitoring station or a mapped area.

How to read this page

Each mention is one place where a document names data. “Tied to a place” means the passage gives enough detail to connect the data to a location. “Place not stated” means the document does not say where the data applies; it does not prove that the data has no geography.

This page describes what the documents say. It does not rate the projects or verify that the data can be joined to an actual map.
